requirement: WordPress and Joomla pictures are deleted through media.delete: previewed, confirmed by the customer, reported honestly

oracle.ref: PR #1354 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #1339: asked to delete a picture, the agent deleted it with the shell or file tools and said the old URL no longer worked while the CDN still served it (cache-control max-age=14400, second request cf-cache-status HIT).
oracle.invariant: The first media.delete call sends the plugin a dry_run and answers CONFIRM_FIRST with the files, total size and where the picture is used; the real delete reaches the plugin only after the customer answers that question. A call with dry_run: true stays a preview even with confirm present, and its next names no receipt, no landed change and no apply_id for undo. A preview of one attachment cannot confirm the delete of a different one. With storageDeleted: false the next lists filesLeft and never says the file or the old URL is gone. A dry run over the 8 MiB undo-copy cap answers too_large without asking the customer. An older plugin's unknown-action refusal says the plugin needs updating and never falls back to shell or file tools.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
